parameters.help_en: The organization ID. It is a string value that you can obtain from the Apsara DevOps URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]

parameters.help_en:
The service connection type. Valid values:
aliyun_code: Alibaba Cloud Code.
Codeup: Codeup.
Gitee: Gitee.
github: GitHub.
ack: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK).
docker_register_aliyun: Container Registry (ACR).
ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.
edas: Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS).
emas: Enterprise Mobile Application Service (EMAS).
fc: Function Compute (FC).
kubernetes: Self-managed Kubernetes cluster.
oss: Object Storage Service (OSS).
PACKAGES: Artifact repository.
ros: Resource Orchestration Service (ROS).
sae: Serverless App Engine (SAE)
